description.narrative: The Project is expected to deliver substantial environmental and social benefits by supporting Bradescos growth in its sustainable finance portfolio. Specifically, the financing will help the Bank fund its commitment under the Brazilian government's Ecoinvest Program which is expected to include but not limited to renewable energy generation, sustainable transportation and blue assets.

The proposed project consists of an up to US$275 million senior loan to Banco Bradesco S.A. (the Bank or Bradesco). The proposed investment aims to support the Banks lending program to sustainable projects (the Project), with a focus on assets eligible under the Brazilian Ecoinvest program (Ecoinvest Program).
